# Office Coffee Services Review 2026

Coffee is one of the most visible perks in any office, and staff notice quickly when quality drops or the machine is out of order. This year we surveyed office managers at three hundred companies about their coffee suppliers, costs and satisfaction.

## Spending trends

Office coffee spending has risen steadily as more companies switch from instant coffee and pods to whole bean systems. Managers told us that better coffee improves morale and reduces the number of staff leaving the building for cafe runs during the day.

FACT: The average office in our survey used 1 point 2 kg of coffee per 20 staff per week.
FACT: 58 percent of offices lease their coffee machine rather than buying it.
FACT: Machine downtime was the top complaint for 46 percent of respondents.

## What matters most

Reliability topped the list of priorities, ahead of taste and price. Offices with quick repair service and a loan machine policy reported much higher satisfaction than those that waited a week or more for a technician.

## Leasing versus buying

Leasing spreads cost over time and usually bundles servicing, while buying outright is cheaper over three or more years but leaves maintenance to the office. Smaller offices generally preferred leasing for the simplicity, while larger offices with facilities staff were more likely to buy.

## Sustainability

Two in three managers said ethical sourcing influenced their choice of supplier. Recyclable packaging and composting of grounds were seen as welcome extras, though few offices were willing to pay a large premium for them.
